description:
StarterKit modular monolith template pack for ASP.NET Core on .NET 10. Contains the
      solution template (short name mm-sln: framework building blocks, host, Identity and
      Notifications modules, migrators, tests, and the Next.js admin client) plus two module
      templates for adding new modules: mm (single implementation project plus Contracts) and
      ca-mm (Clean Architecture split into Domain, Application, Infrastructure and Contracts).
releaseNotes:
* Solution template mm-sln: framework, host, Identity and Notifications modules, Next.js admin client
      * Module templates: mm (single project + Contracts) and ca-mm (Domain/Application/Infrastructure + Contracts)
      * Module templates now follow the real module layout: StarterKit.Modules.ModuleName namespaces, AppModule/AppModuleConsumer scaffolding, AddModuleNameServices registration
      * Fixed the corrupted ca-mm Domain project file
title: ASP.NET Core Modular Monolith Solution Template
